free_resources.title: Prayers for Anxiety to Soothe Your Soul
free_resources.description: A free blog guide to praying through worry, drawing on Bible passages such as Matthew 6:34 on staying with today, followed by three short prayers built on well-known scriptures.

free_resources.title: Prayers For Peaceful Sleep
free_resources.description: Three free bedtime prayers, each resting on a verse (Matthew 7:7, Psalm 3:5, Matthew 11:28), for ending the day in gratitude and handing its weight over to God before sleep.

free_resources.title: 4 Prayers For Anger Management And Peace
free_resources.description: Four free Christian prayers for different kinds of anger, from frustration at things outside your control to resentment towards others, with a closing prayer on righteous anger.

left_out: Other sleep and anxiety posts (e.g. 'Hopeful Bible Verses for Depression and Anxiety', 'Anxiety in Teens', sleep-tip and insomnia articles): not added; three prayer posts chosen to keep free resources at 5, and the tip articles are general advice rather than practice.
